title: Survey Assistant
abstract: Are you interested in surveying or 3D Scanning? Join an exciting company in a role where we will help you become a top-notch surveyor.
bullets: No survey experience required - on-job training provided
Looking to become a surveyor or interested in 3D scanning?
Long term employment prospects in a fun and progressive survey firm

content_text:
Sonto is on a mission.
We aim to deliver exceptional surveying services across South-East Queensland through an innovative business model that empowers our team members to achieve both professional and personal success. Our high-performing team takes pride in providing reliable, high-quality surveying solutions that our clients can depend on. At Sonto, we value every team member’s contributions and ownership of their roles, fostering a culture of growth, support, and accountability.
Our vision extends beyond business success—we strive to positively impact our clients, team, environment, and community. Join us, and be part of a company that makes a difference.
About the Role
We are offering an exciting opportunity to join our field survey team as a Survey Assistant. In this role, you’ll assist field surveyors on a variety of design, construction, cadastral, and engineering projects. Through hands-on training and mentorship, you’ll gain a broad understanding of surveying best practices and develop the skills needed to advance your career.
If you’re passionate about becoming a surveyor or exploring opportunities with a progressive survey and spatial data firm, this is the perfect starting point.
Your Responsibilities
As a Survey Assistant, your day-to-day duties will include:
- Preparing project sites and handling survey equipment and pegs.
- Setting up instruments, GPS units, and 3D scanning equipment & drones (potentially).
- Assisting surveyors with fieldwork, including marking points, lines, and offsets with pegs and spray paint.
- Collecting and managing field data under the surveyor’s guidance.
- Setting up and running 3D scanning missions, processing data, and adhering to company QA processes.
- Performing repair work on survey markings as needed.
- Maintaining and stocking vehicles with equipment and supplies.
- Learning and applying industry guidelines and best practices to fieldwork.
What We Offer
- Extensive training and mentorship to help you achieve your career goals.
- Exposure to a variety of surveying projects, including innovative 3D scanning services.
- A supportive team environment that values growth, innovation, and excellence.
- The opportunity to develop into an independent field surveyor.
About You
This role is suited to someone who is:
- Enthusiastic about pursuing a career in surveying.
- A quick learner, eager to gain hands-on experience in the field.
- Willing to take ownership of their role and responsibilities.
To be considered for this role, you must hold:
- A valid driver’s license.
- A General Construction Induction Card (or be willing to obtain one).
This is an immediate start opportunity to join a dynamic team that will support you in building a fulfilling career. Ready to be part of Sonto’s mission? Apply now!
